svg.title: Five Core Seats, Two Scale Seats
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-06-five-to-seven-person-pod; chart type: org_architecture; title: Five Core Seats, Two Scale Seats; subtitle: Base: 3 FT + 2 C. Scaled: 4 FT + 3 C.; chapter number: 11; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Each numeric value represents one person, not full-time equivalent capacity. The first five seats form the Conservative and Base pod; the final two are Scaled-only additions. Contractor status requires a fact-specific classification assessment, not merely a seat label.; caption: Conservative: $1,000,000 billings and $30,000 owner net with five people. Base: $3,000,000 and $165,000 with five. Scaled: $5,000,000 and $400,000 with seven. The $180,000 Base labor allocation is illustrative and must be tested against actual staffing costs and workload.; stages: label: Founder and commercial lead; value: Core seat one; full-time commercial owner; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Own shipper acquisition, pricing limits, customer concentration, and cash planning. Approve unusual credit exposure without also controlling every payment-master change.; label: Carrier procurement and verification lead; value: Core seat two; full-time carrier owner; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Source capacity, verify carrier identity, negotiate buy rates, and document coverage decisions. Escalate identity conflicts independently of sales pressure.; label: Shipment operations and service lead; value: Core seat three; full-time execution owner; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Run pickup and delivery execution, monitor tracking exceptions, collect proof of delivery, and maintain shipper updates and claims evidence.; label: Billing and reconciliation specialist; value: Core seat four; contracted accounting support; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Match invoices to load records, reconcile carrier payables, monitor receivables aging, and flag duplicate invoices. Separate payment preparation from final release.; label: After-hours tracking specialist; value: Core seat five; contracted coverage support; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Cover agreed monitoring windows, escalate missed milestones, and preserve event logs. One contractor does not provide continuous round-the-clock staffing.; label: Additional account operations manager; value: Scaled seat six; added full-time capacity; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Add only in the seven-person configuration to own repeat-account execution and absorb measured service load without weakening carrier or credit controls.; label: Additional coverage and exception specialist; value: Scaled seat seven; added contracted capacity; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Expand defined coverage windows and document exception resolution during peak demand. Track contracted hours against incremental load contribution and service results.
